issuer: the authorised body for road safety (the central executive body and its territorial subdivisions in the regions, the cities of republican significance and the capital)
note: Read 2026-10-30 on Әділет, the Ministry of Justice's legal information system (rendered in a browser, the site being a script page), in the Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan of 17 April 2014 No. 194-V "On Road Traffic" as currently amended. Art. 74(2) grants the right to drive category "B" to persons who have reached eighteen; art. 73(7) issues the national driving licence for ten years unless a law limits it; art. 10(4) has the authorised body (defined in art. 1(18) as the central executive body for road safety and its territorial subdivisions) set the rules for taking the exams and issuing licences. The state duty for issuing a licence (in the Tax Code) wasn't read, so the fee is null. The identity card is the ids engine's. No exchange list was read.
